senses.gloss:
वैतंसिक वैतंसिक, अस्, m. (fr. वि-तंस), a
vender of flesh, seller of the meat of beasts or birds.

वैतण्डिक वैतण्डिक, अस्, m. (fr. वि-तण्डा), a
disputatious or captious person, one fond of cavilling.
वैतण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of the Vasu Āpa.

वैतथ्य वैतथ्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-तथ),
falseness.

वैतथ्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-तथ), falsehood, un-
truth, untruthfulness.

वैतनिक वैतनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वेतन),
living on wages, subsisting on a stipend; (अस्), m. a
hireling, stipendiary; a labourer.

वैतानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, performed with the three
sacred fires (i. e. with the Gārhapatya, Dakṣiṇa,
and Āhavanīya fires); sacrificial, sacred (as fire);
(अम्), n. a burnt-offering (especially of clarified
butter, as presented daily by the Brāhmans).

वैतरण वैतरण, अस्, m. (fr. वि-तरण),
N. of a physician.

वैतरणि, इस्, or वैतरणी, f., N. of the river
of Hell, i. e. of a river which must be crossed before
entering the infernal regions, (this river is described
as rushing with great impetuosity, hot, fetid in
odour, and filled with blood, hair, and bones; its
name is derived from वि-तरण in the sense either
of ‘crossing’ or ‘giving,’ liberality being supposed
to secure a passage); N. of a division of Naraka or
Hell; of a sacred river in the country of the Kaliṅgas;
N. of the mother of the Rākṣasas.

वैतहव्य वैतहव्य, अस्, m. (fr. वीत-हव्य),
a patronymic of the Vedic Ṛṣi Aruṇa.

वैतान वैतान, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-तान), taken
from the sacred hearth, sacrificial, sacred (as fire);
(अम्), n. an oblation with fire; a sacrificial rite.
—वैतान-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in or con-
versant with sacrificial rites.
—वैतानोपासना (˚न-
उप्˚), f. the regular presentation of burnt-offerings
morning and evening.

वैतालकि वैतालकि, इस्, m., N. of a teacher
of the Ṛg-veda.

वैतालिक वैतालिक, अस्, m. (fr. ताल with 1. वि
or fr. वेताल), a bard whose duty it is to awaken a
chief or prince at dawn with music and song; one
who sings out of tune (?); one who is possessed by
a Vetāla or demon, the servant of a Vetāla; the
worshipper of a Vetāla; a magician, conjurer.

वैतालीय वैतालीय, अम्, n. (fr. वेताल), a
kind of metre (the first and third Pāda containing
fourteen Mātrās or the time of fourteen short sylla-
bles, the second and fourth containing sixteen Mā-
trās; each Pāda closes with a cretic and iambus, i. e.
¯˘¯˘¯; but there are some varieties).

वैतृष्ण्य वैतृष्ण्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-तृष्ण),
freedom from thirst, quenching the thirst.

वैत्रक वैत्रक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वेत्र), cany,
reedy, relating to a cane or stick of any kind.

वैत्रकीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a cane or
stick, reedy.

वैतस्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-तस्ति), measuring a
span.

वैत्तपाल्य (fr. वित्त-पाल), relating to Vitta-
pāla or Kuvera.
